name: Setagaya-Daita
tagline: Shinjuku in 12 minutes and Shibuya in 14 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Odakyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 31 minutes to Otemachi, 12 minutes to Shinjuku, 14 minutes to Shibuya and 40 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 42.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 42.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 29.8 m to 45.2 m, a difference of 15.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 25 clinics and 14 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 島津メディカルクリニック, about 7 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 加藤医院, about 8 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Odakyu Odawara Line.
congestion: Odakyu Odawara Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 世田谷代田→下北沢, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Odakyu Odawara Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
